verdict.rationale: Cua documents a first-party approval gate, but only for credential and vault access. Nothing is read until the operator approves, sensitive items require Touch ID, and items stay locked until unattended access is allowed, including approving an agent's request to sign in with a saved password. Cua Driver also offers agent permission settings, but nothing shows general actions like payments, sends or deletes being intercepted and paused for approval. Missing for 10: action-level approval gates for payments, sends and deletes, detail on what Driver permissions can gate, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
